Ca. 1890-91 photograph of College Green from
  the front of Trinity College, looking down Dame Street with the
  statue of Grattan in the foreground and the "blind porch" of the
  former parliament building at right, held in the National
  Library of Ireland on the Commons. Source: Wikimedia Commons.
